paper: EchoPress: Query-Agnostic KV Cache Pruning via Virtual Context Reconstruction
novelty_audit: Training-free approximation of KVzip reconstruction scores from ordinary-prefill Q/K using RoPE composition, one exact first-chunk reconstruction and per-request per-layer per-KV-head score calibration is existing prior by Sep30 2026. Do not claim this mechanism as a new idea.
code_constraints: EchoPress docstring and _prefill_hook require B=1 and a single full-context prefill forward, incompatible with current dense1024 chunked-prefill reference without a semantic port.
Q normalization in _prefill_hook is guarded by isinstance(module,Qwen3Attention). The official30B is Qwen3MoeAttention, so blindly using this code would omit q_norm on that class.
The fork inherits KVzipPress compression and Cache extraction adapters, and wraps model.model.forward; current Transformers5 DynamicCache and TP2 vLLM integration are not qualified.

RoPE offset composition, reconstruction prompt accounting, first-chunk calibration and global allocation need separate numerical checks. A4 suffix-only query selection cannot substitute for its full-document reconstruction scores.
compatibility_decision: Plausible training-free follow-up for unsupported-gate main model, but not a drop-in validated baseline and no runtime/quality claim. Bounded source audit only; no EchoPress GPU experiment in current allocation.
